description: This Java class 'CommandQueue' manages command sending and confirmation handling for a serial communication interface, including retry logic, listener notifications, and command queuing.

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: Singleton class that manages command queuing, sending, and confirmation handling with retry logic.

classes.name: CommandQueue.MethodInvocation
classes.description: Inner class representing a command invocation with associated parameters.

classes.name: CommandQueue.CommandQueueListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to command events.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for command events.

methods.name: handleConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Processes confirmation messages received from the device.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Enqueues a command for sending with optional timeout and listener.

methods.name: getTimeout
methods.description: Determines timeout based on whether the command is slow.

methods.name: sendPendingCommand
methods.description: Sends the next command in the queue.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command and retries until confirmation is received.
